'''Roxana Moslehi''' ({{langx|fa|رکسانا مصلحی}}) is an [[Iran]]ian-born [[Genetic epidemiology|genetic epidemiologist]].

Her research is on [[cancer]] and cancer precursors, including work on [[radiation-induced cancer]] of the eyes,<ref name="cluster">{{cite news |last=Edwards |first=Lynda |date=February 23, 2018 |title=UAlbany professor pursues cancer cluster mystery |newspaper=Times Union |url=https://www.timesunion.com/news/article/UAlbany-professor-pursues-cancer-cluster-mystery-12704557.php |access-date=2023-11-06}}</ref> genetic and environmental causes of [[ovarian cancer]], and ethnic differences in [[breast cancer]] incidence.<ref>{{cite news |last=Hughes |first=Claire |date=November 11, 2016 |title=Racial disparities persist in breast cancer |newspaper=Times-Union |url=https://www.timesunion.com/tuplus-local/article/Racial-disparities-persist-in-breast-cancer-10609663.php |access-date=2023-11-07}}</ref> She also conducts molecular epidemiologic and genomic studies of other diseases such as [[myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome]] (ME/CFS)<ref>{{Cite web |title=COVID-19 May Be a Trigger for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome {{!}} University at Albany |url=https://www.albany.edu/cihs/news/2022-covid-19-may-be-trigger-myalgic-encephalomyelitischronic-fatigue-syndrome |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=www.albany.edu |language=en}}</ref> and gestational complications.{{cn|date=March 2024}} She is an associate professor in [[epidemiology]] and [[biostatistics]] in the School of Public Health at the [[University at Albany]].<ref name=albany>{{Cite web | url=https://www.albany.edu/sph/faculty/roxana-moslehi |title = Roxana Moslehi|work=Faculty|publisher=University at Albany School of Public Health|access-date=2023-11-06}}</ref>

==Education and career==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=December 2023}}
Moslehi received her B.Sc. with honors, M.Sc., and Ph.D. degrees from the [[University of British Columbia]];<ref name=albany/> her 2000 Ph.D. was supervised by J.M. Friedman and Steven Narod.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.friedmanlab.org/CV_Friedman_2018.pdf|first=Jan|last=Friedman|title=Jan Friedman's curriculum vitae|access-date=2023-11-06}}</ref> 
She was a postdoctoral fellow at the [[National Institutes of Health]] Division of Cancer Epidemiology and Genetics, under the supervision of Mitchell Gail, and while there she received an adjunct assistant professor position at [[George Washington University]].{{cn|date=March 2024}} She is currently an assistant professor at the University of Albany.<ref name=albany/>
